headwords: rượu mời không uống, muốn uống rượu phạt

flags.why: This use belongs to Central and Southern speech, as recorded in the [Huế dialect dictionary](https://khungcuahep.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/T%E1%BB%AB-%C4%90i%E1%BB%83n-Ph%C6%B0%C6%A1ng-Ng%E1%BB%AF-Hu%E1%BA%BF-Tr%E1%BA%A7n-Ng%E1%BB%8Dc-B%E1%BA%A3o.pdf), rather than Northern speech.
The game name is mainly Southern usage and needs a regional label.
The verb is mainly Southern usage and needs a regional label.
This intensifier belongs mainly to formal writing and speech, as described in the [dictionary usage note](https://dictionary.zim.vn/viet-anh/rat-muc-tieng-anh-la-gi).

The name also denotes the many-banded krait, as documented by [Pù Luông Nature Reserve](https://baotonpuluong.vn/web/trang-chu/bao-ton-amp%3B-da-dang-sinh-hoc/bao-ton-bo-sat/ran-cap-nia-bac.html), so identifying it exclusively as the Malayan krait teaches a false species equivalence.
The ebbing-water sense is mainly Central and Southern usage, as noted in [VDict](https://vdict.com/r%E1%BA%B7c%2C3%2C0%2C0.html).
This expression is mainly Southern usage and needs a regional label.
